mapper.select: select id, scenic_area_id, feature_name, feature_type, geometry_type, feature_sub_type, length_meters, properties_json, geojson, status, deleted, create_time, update_time from scenic_geo_feature where id = #{id} and deleted = 0 limit 1

select id, scenic_area_id, feature_name, feature_type, geometry_type, feature_sub_type, length_meters, properties_json, geojson, status, deleted, create_time, update_time from scenic_geo_feature where scenic_area_id = #{scenicAreaId} and deleted = 0 order by create_time desc, id desc

select id, scenic_area_id, feature_name, feature_type, geometry_type, feature_sub_type, length_meters, properties_json, geojson, status, deleted, create_time, update_time from scenic_geo_feature where scenic_area_id = #{scenicAreaId} and status = 1 and deleted = 0 order by create_time desc, id desc
mapper.insert: insert into scenic_geo_feature ( scenic_area_id, feature_name, feature_type, geometry_type, feature_sub_type, length_meters, properties_json, geojson, status, deleted, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{scenicAreaId}, #{featureName}, #{featureType}, #{geometryType}, #{featureSubType}, #{lengthMeters}, #{propertiesJson}, #{geojson}, #{status}, #{deleted}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.update:
update scenic_geo_feature
scenic_area_id = #{scenicAreaId},
feature_name = #{featureName},
feature_type = #{featureType},
geometry_type = #{geometryType},
feature_sub_type = #{featureSubType},
length_meters = #{lengthMeters},
properties_json = #{propertiesJson},
geojson = #{geojson},

where id = #{id} and deleted = 0
